title: Update Form Field
prompt: A React form stores field values in one object. Write an immutable helper that returns a new object with one field updated to the provided value.

explanation.beginner: Start by identifying what the function receives and what it must return. For Update Form Field, read the story as a simple input-to-output rule: A React form stores field values in one object. Write an immutable helper that returns a new object with one field updated to the provided value. Work through one small example by hand, then write the steps in React using plain variables before worrying about making the code shorter.
